note: The reported symptom is that dxc crashes/fails internally because a reference-returning intrinsic/operator result used directly (without an intermediate local) never gets its type annotation added, per tex3d's 2024-01-31 comment ('I was able to crash the current code due to a missing annotation still with this'). internal_failure keys on exit status first (0x80000003/0xE0000001 assert trap-or-exception, 0xC0000005 access violation, DXC's internal HRESULTs) and text markers second, so it recognises the defect whether it surfaces as a trapped assert (Debug) or an unchecked null/garbage annotation reached later. An ordinary diagnosed E_FAIL with a plain 'error:' line is NOT a match. Control: control-with-temp.hlsl assigns the same GetThreadNodeOutputRecords(2) result to a ThreadNodeOutputRecords<RECORD1> local first (the documented workaround, and the shape every pre-existing FileCheck test in nodeoutputarray.hlsl uses) and must score no-match.
